source_snapshot.test_name: Check GPU Libraries is suitable for rocHPL
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Build rocHPL and run the exact P=2, Q=4, N=256400, NB=512 workload to assess GPU-library suitability.
procedure_facts: Clones the live ROCm/rocHPL repository, runs install.sh, then invokes /opt/amd-apps/rocHPL/build/mpirun_rochpl.
Attended time is 20 minutes and machine time is 30 minutes.
criteria_facts: Result meets an unspecified specification and has no issues.
missing_source_information: Pinned source/toolchain recipe and build destination.
Eight-rank GPU/process mapping, capacity calculation, HPL residual threshold and performance target.

original_test_intent.statement: Demonstrate that the approved AMD GPU libraries and distributed runtime can build and execute the specified eight-process-grid rocHPL problem correctly and at the required platform performance.
must_preserve: Numerical correctness, performance and error-free system evidence.
The single source-defined benchmark activity, not a substitute inventory query.
must_not_infer: That P x Q identifies physical GPU count or placement without the launcher mapping.
That a zero process exit alone is HPL PASS.
A universal performance threshold for all AMD GPU models.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 preserves the exact rocHPL parameters and gates the live clone/install and sustained distributed workload on pinned artifacts, topology/capacity, cooling and approval.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not quantify that P x Q launches eight MPI processes, distinguish process-grid dimensions from GPU count, or explicitly require the HPL residual PASS plus GFLOP/s evidence as separate acceptance axes.

related_records: Other GPU benchmarks do not supply this case's AMD model, MPI binding or performance baseline.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The source command and parameters are controlling facts; current upstream documentation clarifies their semantics but does not authorize a different workload.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the exact eight-rank process grid and problem size. Build only an approved pinned rocHPL/toolchain, prove rank-to-GPU/CPU mapping and memory fit, then judge residual correctness and model-specific performance separately.

conditions_present: Exact P/Q/N/NB command and nominal 30-minute machine time.
missing: Pinned commit/checksum, reviewed installer, compatible ROCm/MPI stack, rank/GPU binding, memory-workspace calculation, residual/performance limits and abort/recovery policy.
provider: Platform owner supplies recipe, target topology and performance specification.
Lab owner approves installation/load window and limits.
safe_read_only_work: Collect OS, ROCm, driver, GPU UUID/BDF/model/memory, CPU/NUMA, MPI, link topology, free space and thermal/power baselines.
prohibited_until_resolved: Live repository clone, install.sh, dependency mutation, benchmark launch, parameter substitution or PASS.
closure_evidence: Pinned artifact review and reproducible build recipe.
Eight-rank binding/capacity proof and approved thresholds/window.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate AMD GPU Library Stack with the Specified rocHPL Workload
revision_candidate.purpose: Build the approved rocHPL revision and execute exactly P=2, Q=4, N=256400 and NB=512 to verify distributed GPU-library/runtime interoperability, HPL numerical correctness and platform-specific FP64 performance without system errors.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The specified AMD Instinct server topology, supported ROCm/driver/rocBLAS/MPI/UCX stack and approved host OS. P and Q define the MPI process grid; they do not by themselves prove GPU count or rank placement.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One approved benchmark activity using an eight-process MPI grid, with every launched rank mapped to the intended GPU and CPU/NUMA resources. Preserve the source's 30-minute machine-time expectation as a planning value, not a replacement timeout or pass limit.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Pinned rocHPL commit/archive and checksum; reviewed install/build recipe and dependency versions; eight-rank GPU/CPU/NUMA mapping; N/NB device-memory and workspace fit; AMD/platform residual and GFLOP/s acceptance values; power/thermal limits; maintenance timeout/abort/rollback approval; protected evidence path.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture baseline versions, topology, capacity, health and logs. Build the pinned source in the approved isolated path, preserving all output and resulting binary identity. Verify launcher expansion to eight ranks and the approved rank-to-GPU/CPU binding, then run `/opt/amd-apps/rocHPL/build/mpirun_rochpl -P 2 -Q 4 -N 256400 --NB 512` once under the approved guardrails. Preserve complete HPL output, residual verdict, GFLOP/s, bindings and telemetry; compare correctness and performance independently.
revision_candidate.preconditions: No active conflicting workloads; artifacts and installer reviewed; compatible stack and capacity proven; all GPUs healthy; cooling/power/OOB and abort controls available; explicit approval recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Artifact commit/checksum and installer review; OS/kernel/ROCm/driver/rocBLAS/MPI/UCX and binary identity; GPU UUID/BDF/model/memory and CPU/NUMA/link topology; eight-rank binding; capacity calculation; exact command/status; full stdout/stderr and HPL.out; residual value and PASSED/FAILED line; GFLOP/s and threshold comparison; GPU power/temperature/clock/error telemetry; dmesg/XID/RAS/PCIe/BMC/SEL deltas; cleanup state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Approved platform recipe and performance specification plus the pinned rocHPL revision's residual criterion. Complete only when the exact parameters ran with the intended eight-rank mapping, residual correctness passed, measured performance met the applicable model/topology threshold, and no disqualifying system errors occurred.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not execute a moving repository head or unreviewed installer, infer rank binding, reduce N/ranks, change NB, run on busy GPUs, ignore capacity/cooling, auto-retry a failure, clear evidence or treat exit zero as benchmark PASS.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner approves source/toolchain, topology, capacity, threshold, installation changes and sustained-load window; engineer judges residual/performance and anomalous logs.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Artifact approval and result judgment are human decisions; the agent may collect baselines, build, launch, monitor and package evidence after authorization.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On build/dependency, OOM, MPI hang, residual, GPU/RAS/link, thermal or power failure, terminate approved ranks, preserve partial output, return GPUs to idle, restore only via the approved build/toolchain plan and verify host/GPU health before any retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unpinned/unreviewed code; incompatible stack; unknown rank binding or capacity; unhealthy/missing GPU; absent thresholds/approval/recovery; OOM/hang; residual failure; GPU reset/XID/RAS/AER; thermal/power limit breach; incomplete output.

identified_defects: P x Q semantics and eight-process requirement were not explicit.
Residual correctness and performance were not separated.
The live installer can clone/build transitive dependencies.
reason_for_change: Make the exact distributed workload executable without confusing MPI-grid geometry with hardware topology or accepting a performance number without numerical correctness.

new_technical_evidence.title: ROCm rocHPL README - Running rocHPL benchmark application
new_technical_evidence.version: Repository documentation accessed 2026-10-14; revision must be pinned at execution
new_technical_evidence.applicability: rocHPL launcher semantics, not a platform performance specification
new_technical_evidence.supports: P and Q are MPI-grid dimensions, total processes equal P x Q, output includes performance and residual PASS/FAIL.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Target GPU model, supported recipe, rank binding and required performance remain owner-supplied.

new_technical_evidence.title: rocHPL build helper script
new_technical_evidence.version: main accessed 2026-10-14; moving head is not approved
new_technical_evidence.supports: The helper can install dependencies and clone/build MPI/UCX, so review/pinning and rollback boundaries are required.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source's `/opt/amd-apps` binary may come from a different internal recipe.

removed_ambiguities: States eight MPI processes without assuming eight GPUs.
Separates residual correctness from GFLOP/s acceptance.
Treats 30 minutes as source planning time rather than an invented pass limit.
resolved_blockers: Missing packages and thresholds are furnishable prerequisites, not permanent automation blockers.
remaining_blockers: Pinned recipe, binding/capacity proof, thresholds and execution approval are not supplied.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 ties the exact P=2/Q=4 workload to eight MPI ranks, demands evidence of each rank's GPU/CPU binding, and requires both the rocHPL residual verdict and a model-specific performance comparison rather than accepting exit status or score alone.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator preserved all four fixed parameters, interpreted P x Q as eight MPI ranks without assuming eight GPUs, retained 30 minutes as planning metadata, and required both residual correctness and platform performance.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 152 runs rocHPL with P=2, Q=4, N=256400 and NB=512 after install.sh.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserved parameters; V3 makes their eight-rank semantics and dual correctness/performance acceptance explicit.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only inventory is allowed before pinning the installer/toolchain and approving the high-load run.
